credits.title: Madame Jacques on the Croisette
credits.overview: A César Award winning short film about an elderly Jewish couple playing cards in Cannes who find love at an unexpected age.

credits.title: La Haine
credits.overview: After a chaotic night of rioting in a marginal suburb of Paris, three young friends, Vinz, Hubert and Saïd, wander around unoccupied waiting for news about the state of health of a mutual friend who has been seriously injured when confronting the police.

credits.title: Métisse
credits.overview: Lola is pregnant, and she isn’t sure who the father is: Félix, a Jewish delivery boy, or Jamal, a black law student.
